section_header: REAR AXLE AND SUSPENSION — IRS Type Rear Suspension
title: INSTALLATION OF REAR SUSPENSION ARM

content.description: Diagram showing SST tool pressing outer and inner bushings into the arm, with downward arrows indicating pressing direction

content.text: (e) Using SST, press the outer and inner bushings into the arm.
Do not allow grease or oil to get on the bushings.
(a) Align the complete mark at the same position it was before removal.

content.description: Diagram showing alignment mark on suspension arm component
Diagram showing suspension arm installation in vehicle chassis

items: INSTALL BACKING PLATE OR DUST COVER
INSTALL BRAKE DRUM OR DISC ROTOR
CONNECT STABILIZER BAR TO LOWER ARM
